quarterly_data.quarter: Vicor press release: Vicor acquires sites for additional ChiP fabs (09-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vicor is purchasing a 334,000 square foot building on 66 acres of industrial land in Merrimack, New Hampshire and, separately, 54 acres in Hooksett, New Hampshire. The two sites will support the build-out of ChiP Fab-2 and Fab-3 with a combined footprint of nearly one million square feet, expanding total capacity beyond ChiP Fab-1 (built out to 320,000 square feet on 16 acres in Andover, Massachusetts). Fab-1 utilization is approaching capacity. ChiP Fab-2 has a one-year lead time to initial deployment; Vicor says the expansion will provide the scalability needed to support OEMs and hyperscalers seeking Freedom to Operate and U.S. sourcing.
quarterly_data.figure: Merrimack 334,000 square foot building on 66 acres plus 54 acres in Hooksett; Fab-2 and Fab-3 combined footprint nearly one million square feet; one-year lead time to initial deployment for Fab-2
